messages:
Asha: quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: API/Console/Optimize timelines. dropping questions here so leadership can confirm details.
Ben: go for it. happy to clarify.
Priya: first Q: Optimize caching suggestions 1: will beta include automatic prefix caching recommendations or only batching/quantization?
Ben: beta will include batching + prefix/KV caching recommendations for stateless request patterns. sticky session caching (per-customer) is planned for Q3.
Asha: second Q: API rate-limit changes mentioned during the demo 1: when will the new burst limits land, and will they be opt-in?
Ben: burst limit increase is a backend toggle we plan to enable during Console beta for EA accounts. general rollout will be phased with monitoring for abuse signals. it's opt-in for EA.
Marco: about Console UX: will the new rollout timeline editor let PMs schedule gradual ramp-ups (e.g., weekday-only ramp)? engineering needs to know if scheduling rules are supported.
Ben: yes, Console rollout editor supports time-based windows and day-of-week constraints in beta. advanced cron rules will come after beta.
Priya: for Dedicated customers: can Optimize use real perf traces to create caching suggestions? some teams asked about how accurate recommendations will be.
Ben: Dedicated + Private with permission can supply perf traces; Optimize will produce personalized recommendations with tighter confidence intervals. default hosted behavior uses sampled microbenchmarks.
Asha: any privacy/compliance opt-out for traces?
Ben: opt-out is supported. when opted out we use conservative defaults and a wider error band in the UI. this is documented in the privacy section of the beta FAQ.
Marco: rollout safety: will Console ship an auto-rollback if quality regresses beyond a threshold, or is that left to customer tooling?
Ben: Console will have a built-in auto-rollback primitive for canaries configured with simple metric rules (latency p99 increase, failure rate, quality drop). customers can still plug external systems if they prefer.
deploy-bot: [notice] console-rollout branch deployed to staging at commit f2d4c9a 1: smoke tests passed.
Priya: ETA ask: can we get a one-paragraph blurb for customer comms? Sales wants a short line on what to tell customers about risk and opt-in process.
Ben: I'll draft a blurb and post in #marketing by EOD tomorrow.
Asha: awesome. if folks want to review the migration checklist, please ping me. i'll collect feedback and publish in #devex. thanks! :rocket:
